Every swept leg carries reversed false and the sweep holds only these legs for L107, so no later reversal is mixed in. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: an ACCRUAL_ADJUSTMENT posts the SAME interest pair as an accrual with the accounts SWAPPED: DEBIT 8 and CREDIT 7 instead of the accrual's DEBIT 7 and CREDIT 8; a port that ignores the adjustment flag posts the accrual sides and moves BOTH legs' account and side cells while the count and amounts stay observed. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive fee or penalty group on an adjustment (both zero here; the swap for those groups is the same code path but unobserved), and the tax branch or any charge-specific GL mapping (no input exists for them). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
